object.description: Read a document without DOC.rules.xml. Read one whose rules file holds a rule when type='Heading' then attr rationale forbidden, and a rule when type='Functional' has-outgoing-link='false' then attr rationale required; one whose rule tests status='Approved'; one with a link directive to PARENT with status required; one with a link directive without target-doc. Create a document with the default schema. Expected: no rules without the file; each rule reads with its conditions and directives as written; the link directive reads with its target document and status required; the one without target-doc is a load error; the new document has <document ID>.rules.xml beside its manifest, holding rules.
